item.title: Legend Elixir by Montblanc – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Montblanc
Type:
Price: 3.49 - 22.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Legend Elixir is the richest take on Montblanc's Legend line, a Parfum that warms lavender, cardamom and pink pepper with cinnamon and iris over a deep vanilla, benzoin and labdanum base. Composed by Antoine Maisondieu and Guillaume Flavigny, it is a smooth, spicy-sweet evening scent. Genuine Montblanc, hand-decanted from a full bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Bergamot
Middle: Cinnamon, Iris, Pomarose, Clary Sage
Base: Vanilla, Ambrofix, Benzoin, Labdanum

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out, special occasions · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Explorer by Montblanc – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Montblanc
Type:
Price: 2.00 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Explorer is Montblanc's woody aromatic leather Eau de Parfum, opening with bergamot, pink pepper and clary sage over Haitian vetiver and soft leather, with an ambroxan and patchouli trail. Composed by Antoine Maisondieu, Jordi Fernandez and Olivier Pescheux, it is an easy, versatile everyday signature. Genuine Montblanc, hand-decanted from a full bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Clary Sage
Middle: Haitian Vetiver, Leather
Base: Ambroxan, Akigalawood, Patchouli, Cacao Pod

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday, gym · Time: daytime

item.title: Petra by Lattafa – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Lattafa
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Petra is a boozy, sun-warmed Eau de Parfum from Lattafa, pairing rum and juicy plum with creamy tuberose and coconut over a praline, vanilla and musk base. It opens rich and rummy, then softens into a warm, tropical skin glow that lasts for hours.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Rum, Plum
Middle: Tuberose, Coconut
Base: Vanilla, Musk, Praline

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:

Overview

Hawas Pink is a sweet, spiced gourmand floral from Rasasi, an Eau de Parfum that wraps cinnamon and nutmeg around fluffy marshmallow, tuberose and orange blossom, often compared to Kilian Love Don't Be Shy. The drydown is a soft cotton-candy, vanilla and tonka glow.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Neroli
Middle: Marshmallow, Tuberose, Orange Blossom
Base: Cotton Candy, Vanilla, Tonka Bean

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: evening

item.description:
Vendor: French Avenue
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Eclair Affair is a creamy, dessert-sweet Eau de Parfum from French Avenue, layering vanilla bean and coconut milk over caramel and amber for a soft, powdery pastry glow, often compared to Giardini di Toscana Bianco Latte. It wears warm and cosy, with a smooth tonka and musk drydown.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Vanilla Bean, Coconut Milk, Jasmine
Middle: Caramel, Gourmand Accord, Amber
Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: day and night

item.title: Odyssey Toro by Armaf – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 44.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Odyssey Toro is an icy, high-energy fruity citrus from Armaf, an Eau de Parfum that opens with grapefruit, blood orange, pineapple and frosted mint before settling into a warm, creamy amber and vanilla base. Bright and chilled up top, smooth on the dry-down, it is made for active days and big-energy moments.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Sicilian Lemon, Blood Orange, Apple, Raspberry, Pineapple, Mint, Icy Accord
Middle: Jasmine, Lily, Mint Tea, Sage
Base: Amber, Peru Balsam, Patchouli, Ambroxan, Vanilla, Musk

item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 44.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Odyssey Ring My Bell is the freshest member of Armaf's Odyssey Spicy Collection, an Eau de Parfum built around a crisp green bell pepper accord. Sharp Timur pepper and zesty grapefruit open onto bell pepper warmed by black pepper, finishing on a clean, earthy base of vetiver, patchouli and cedarwood.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Timur Pepper, Grapefruit
Middle: Bell Pepper Accord, Black Pepper
Base: Vetiver, Patchouli, Cedarwood

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday, casual daytime

item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 44.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Odyssey Orange Soda Pop captures the bright, bubbly feel of an ice-cold orange soda on a hot day, an Eau de Parfum from Armaf that sits alongside the cola-style Odyssey Soda Pop. Fizzy citrus, sparkling orange and cooling mint open onto rose, lily of the valley and juicy fig, settling on golden dates, soft musk and warm amber.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citrus Fizz, Sparkling Orange, Lemon, Citron, Mint, Watery Accords, Black Currant
Middle: May Rose, Lily of the Valley, Carrot Seed, Fig, Coriander
Base: Dates, Musk, Amber

Overview

Odyssey Jalapeach-O is the sweetest, most playful member of Armaf's Odyssey Spicy Collection, an Eau de Parfum that pairs juicy peach with a green jalapeño accord. Peach, lemon and Timur pepper open onto freesia and jalapeño, drying down to a warm, nutty base of praline, tonka, patchouli and moss.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Timur Pepper, Lemon, Peach
Middle: Freesia, Jalapeño Accord
Base: Patchouli, Praline, Moss, Tonka Bean

Odyssey Diam Black is a dark, warm amber-woody Eau de Parfum from Armaf, made for evenings and presented in a faceted black bottle. Orange, iced dates, pistachio and cardamom lead into a boozy heart of caramel, ambery rum and plum, finishing on tonka, sandalwood, myrrh and benzoin.

Overview

Odyssey Bloody Hot is the bold, savoury member of Armaf's Odyssey Spicy Collection, an Eau de Parfum built around a Bloody Mary accord. Black pepper, strawberry and bergamot open onto a floral-spicy heart of rose, geranium and osmanthus, settling into an earthy, smouldering base of patchouli, benzoin and labdanum.

Middle: Bloody Mary Accord, Rose, Geranium, Osmanthus

item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 54.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Dubai Waterfall is a smooth, warm Extrait de Parfum from Armaf's Dubai line. Calabrian bergamot, aromatic geranium and fresh green accords open onto velvety rose, warm spices and soft powdery florals, then dry down to a rich, balsamic trail of golden benzoin, Peru balsam, guaiac wood and musk.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Calabrian Bergamot, Geranium, Green Accords
Middle: Rose, Warm Spices, Powdery Florals
Base: Benzoin, Peru Balsam, Guaiac Wood, Musk

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, special occasions · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 54.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Club de Nuit Iconic is a clean, polished blue-style scent from Armaf, an Eau de Parfum that opens bright with grapefruit, lemon and mint before settling into a smoky, woody base of incense, cedar and sandalwood. It is one of the most popular everyday blue fragrances around, often compared to Chanel Bleu de Chanel. Full bottles are the big 200ml (6.8oz) size.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Lemon, Mint, Pink Pepper, Coriander
Middle: Ginger, Melon, Jasmine, Nutmeg
Base: Incense, Amber, Sandalwood, Cedar, Patchouli, Labdanum, Woody Notes

Best for

Season: Spring, summer, fall and winter · Wear it: office, everyday, date night · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:
Vendor: Amar Parfums
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Supreme Black Pour Homme by Amar Parfums is a sweet, spicy-woody Eau de Parfum for men. Roasted pineapple and blood orange open with a cardamom spark, then a rich vanilla and coconut heart, lifted by clary sage, melts into ebony wood, patchouli and tonka. A warm, sweet evening scent, often compared to Rabanne 1 Million Black.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Roasted Pineapple, Blood Orange, Cardamom
Middle: Vanilla Accord, Coconut Accord, Clary Sage
Base: Ebony Wood Accord, Patchouli, Tonka Bean

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out, special occasions · For: him

item.title: Borouj Mysterious by Dumont – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Dumont
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (5 variants)

Overview

Borouj Mysterious by Dumont is an Eau de Parfum that opens bright and juicy with bergamot, green notes and sugar cane, before melon, pineapple and jasmine add a sweet, fruity glow over a powdery amber-vanilla trail. A smooth, sweet-woody unisex scent, often compared to Xerjoff Erba Pura.

The dry-down settles into soft vanilla, white musk, cedar and moss, warm and easy to wear from spring days into fall evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Amber, Bergamot, Green Notes, Sugar Cane
Middle: Melon, Pineapple, Jasmine, Cedar, Gourmand Accord, Mineral Notes
Base: Amber, Vanilla, White Musk, Cedar, Woody Notes, Moss

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: date night, nights out · For: him and her

item.description:
Vendor: Jo Milano
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Game of Spades Full House Extrait is the richer, more concentrated version of Jo Milano's Full House: an Extrait de Parfum that pairs sparkling citrus with a warm ginger-cinnamon heart and a smooth black tea, guaiac wood and incense dry-down. It's bright and polished up top, then settles into a longer, deeper trail than the original, often compared to Louis Vuitton Imagination.

A unisex scent that wears clean and refined, easy to reach for on any day you want to smell put-together.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citron, Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Orange
Middle: Tunisian Neroli, Nigerian Ginger, Ceylon Cinnamon
Base: Chinese Black Tea, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood, Olibanum

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:

Effects of Uniq is a sweet, warm gourmand Eau de Parfum from Armaf's Uniq line. Juicy pear and mandarin lead into creamy orange blossom and vanilla. It settles into a dark, cosy base of coffee, caramel, cedar and patchouli, often compared to Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pear, Mandarin
Middle: Orange Blossom, Vanilla
Base: Coffee, Caramel, Cedarwood, Patchouli, White Musk

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, night out · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:
Vendor: Jo Milano
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Game of Spades Face Card is a confident fresh-spicy Extrait de Parfum from Jo Milano's 2026 Game of Spades line. Crisp citron, bergamot and juniper open onto lavender, geranium, nutmeg and cypress, before drying down to a warm woody base of ambrox, patchouli and sandalwood. Fresh, aromatic and polished, with the staying power of an extrait.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citron, Bergamot, Juniper
Middle: Lavender, Geranium, Nutmeg, Cypress
Base: Ambrox, Patchouli, Sandalwood

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night · Performance: long-lasting

Overview

Palawan is a bright, tropical Eau de Parfum from Rayhaan's 2026 line, made in collaboration with Noel Thomas. Sharp calamansi and grapefruit meet juicy pineapple, softened by orange blossom and fig over a clean bed of sandalwood and white musk. A sunny, easy-wearing scent for warm days.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Calamansi, Grapefruit, Yellow Mandarin, Pineapple
Middle: Orange Blossom, Pomarose, Fig
Base: Sandalwood, White Musk, Dry Amber

item.description:

Type:
Price: 2.99 - 69.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Royal Ispahan by Mykonos is a soft, romantic Extrait de Parfum that opens bright and juicy with bergamot, raspberry and lychee over a touch of cotton flower. Violet and a creamy rose-milk accord make up the heart, and vanilla, guaiac wood and amber settle it into a warm, velvety finish. It is a sweet, feminine rose scent often compared to Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Raspberry, Lychee, Cotton Flower
Middle: Violet, Rose Milk, Soft Woods
Base: Vanilla, Guaiac Wood, Amber

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: date night, special occasions, everyday

item.description:

Type:

Overview

Dark Secret by Mykonos is a rich, mysterious Extrait de Parfum that opens on juicy black cherry lifted by saffron and bergamot. A warm heart of cinnamon, nutmeg, jasmine and praline follows, and amber, tonka, sandalwood and musk give it a deep, sweet, lingering finish. It is a dark cherry evening scent often compared to Tom Ford Lost Cherry.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Black Cherry, Saffron, Bergamot
Middle: Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Marigold, Jasmine, Praline
Base: Amber, Musk, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out, special occasions · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:

Overview

Paladin is a warm, aromatic vanilla-and-lavender Eau de Parfum, often compared to Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Intense. Smooth vanilla opens straight into a clean, herbal lavender heart, and the drydown turns earthy and slightly smoky with vetiver. Sweet, fresh and quietly powerful.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Vanilla
Middle: Lavender, Aromatic Notes
Base: Vetiver

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: evening

item.description:

Overview

Hera is a bright, softly sweet fruity-floral Eau de Parfum, often compared to Parfums de Marly Palatine. Juicy pear and mandarin open over a lavender-and-violet heart, then settle into a clean, creamy base of musk, sandalwood and vanilla. An easy, polished unisex scent for everyday wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pear, Mandarin Orange, Citrus
Middle: Lavender, Violet
Base: Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Patchouli

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday · Time: daytime

item.title: Dirty Heaven by BORNTOSTANDOUT – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: BORNTOSTANDOUT
Type:
Price: 5.99 - 44.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Dirty Heaven is BORNTOSTANDOUT's luminous white-floral gourmand, an Eau de Parfum from the independent niche house. Bright white flowers open into a heart of jasmine and neroli, then a warm, creamy cloud of tonka bean, vanilla, saffron and ambroxan settles in, with white musks, grey amber and modern woods adding a subtly sensual, skin-like edge. Ethereal and addictive, it is sweet without being simple.

Fragrance Notes

Top: White Flowers
Middle: Jasmine, Neroli
Base: Tonka Bean, Saffron, Ambroxan, Vanilla, White Musks, Grey Amber, Modern Woods

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out; day or evening

Try It Before You Commit

No two people wear a scent quite the same way. Try a decant over several wears to get to know it before committing to a full bottle.

item.description:

Type:

Overview

Club de Nuit Timeless is a warm, spiced leather-and-tobacco Eau de Parfum from Armaf, released in 2026. Black pepper, nutmeg, cardamom and hazelnut open it with a toasty, spicy glow, cinnamon, rose and frankincense build a smoky heart, and honeyed tobacco, suede, amber, sandalwood and vanilla give it a rich, dressed-up base. It is a cosy, grown-up scent for cool evenings and dinners out.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Black Pepper, Nutmeg, Cardamom, Hazelnut, Bergamot
Middle: Cinnamon, Rose, Frankincense, Lavender
Base: Tobacco, Suede, Amber, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Akigalawood

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions; evenings
